verdict.rationale: Inner Harbor Block has the strongest conference-access advantage, but Harbor East offers quiet and a hot tub for only a short additional trip, Fells Point offers the best rating and restaurant at a modestly lower listed price, and BWI-Area offers lower cost plus full amenities in exchange for a substantial commute. The query gives no priority among commute convenience, amenities, quiet, dining, rating, and savings. It also says rates are within $15 while the listed range is $214 to $242, making the price tradeoff internally inconsistent. No option clearly dominates under ordinary travel reasoning.
